prompt: Design error response format for a payment API that handles validation errors, insufficient funds, and rate limiting.

assertions.name: structured_error_fields
assertions.description: Error format includes machine-readable id, human-readable message, and optional url

assertions.name: appropriate_status_codes
assertions.description: Uses 422 for validation, 402 for insufficient funds, 429 for rate limiting

assertions.name: machine_readable_ids
assertions.description: Error IDs are machine-readable (e.g. validation_error, insufficient_funds, rate_limit)

assertions.name: example_responses
assertions.description: Provides example JSON responses for each error type
